decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sudden large-magnitude multi-axis jump near the end of the first window (indices 538–544), and (2) a prolonged interval (605–729) with ambiguous superposed changes—particularly a possible opposing U-axis return amid continuing N/E trends.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in all axes around index 538–540 (N from ~-2 to +24, E from ~1.3 to ~17.8, U from ~-0.5 to ~23), followed by sustained high-amplitude oscillation; the abrupt onset and scale suggest a permanent offset or major event rather than noise.

Extended region (605–729) showing complex cross-axis behavior: N/E/U exhibit slow drifts with superposed irregular fluctuations; notable is a possible opposing return in U (~22→25→22) while N and E continue rising, suggesting ambiguous superposition of trends or partial recovery after earlier shift.
